remarks: Welcome to 1868 Indian Falls Road in Pembroke, New York — a rare and impressive property that combines space, privacy, and versatility on just under 14 acres of beautiful land. This home offers almost 2700 square feet of living space and features thoughtful design elements throughout. The main home first floor offers a spacious and convenient primary suite, providing comfort and accessibility with a large kitchen and living room combo, bedroom, closet, and private bath. The open-concept layout continues with a bright kitchen, island, eat in dining area, and living room designed for both daily living and entertaining. First floor laundry room. Large windows invite in natural light and offer peaceful views of the surrounding property, creating a sense of tranquility in every room. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom, providing plenty of space for family or guests. The other side of the home includes a fully finished in-law suite, complete with its own kitchen, living area, bedroom, and a full bath with laundry. This space is perfect for extended family, guests, or potential rental income, offering flexibility to suit a variety of needs. Outside, the property continues to impress. An detached two-car garage with lean-to that provides both storage and potential. The possibilities are endless for those looking to expand or create additional value. The outdoor amenities make this home truly special. Enjoy summers outdoors, surrounded by open space and the privacy of your own acreage. Whether you’re hosting gatherings, gardening, or simply enjoying the peace and quiet, this property offers a lifestyle that is both comfortable and full of opportunity. Pembroke School District. Just minutes to NYS Thruway.
